58	class PatchedOpenAIResponsesLLM(StructuredChatMixin, OpenAIResponsesBase):  # type: ignore[misc]
59	    """Patched OpenAI Responses LLM.
60	
61	    Adds reasoning, tools, and structured-output support.
62	    """

64	    @staticmethod
65	    def _build_responses_text_format(structured_outputs: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
66	        """Convert StructuredOutputsParams to Responses API text.format dict."""
67	        from private_gpt.components.llm.custom.base import (
68	            normalize_structured_outputs,
69	        )
70	
71	        structured_outputs = normalize_structured_outputs(structured_outputs)
72	        if structured_outputs is None:
73	            return {"type": "json_object"}
74	
75	        if structured_outputs.json_schema:
76	            return {
77	                "type": "json_schema",
78	                "name": "response",
79	                "strict": True,
80	                "schema": structured_outputs.json_schema,
81	            }
82

85	    def _ensure_valid_reasoning_effort(
86	        self, reasoning_effort: "ReasoningEffort | str | None"
87	    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
88	        """Convert ReasoningEffort to the reasoning_options dict for Responses API."""
89	        if reasoning_effort is None:
90	            return None
91	
92	        effort_enum: ReasoningEffort = (
93	            ReasoningEffort.from_str(reasoning_effort)
94	            if isinstance(reasoning_effort, str)
95	            else reasoning_effort
96	        )
97	
98	        if effort_enum == ReasoningEffort.NONE:
99	            return None
100	
101	        effort_str = _RESPONSES_REASONING_EFFORT_MAP.get(effort_enum, effort_enum.value)
102	        return {"effort": effort_str, "summary": "auto"}

104	    @staticmethod
105	    def _get_stop_reason_from_response(response: Any) -> StopReasonEnum:
106	        """Derive a unified StopReasonEnum from a Responses API Response object."""
107	        status = getattr(response, "status", None)
108	
109	        if status == "incomplete":
110	            incomplete_details = getattr(response, "incomplete_details", None)
111	            reason = getattr(incomplete_details, "reason", None)
112	            match reason:
113	                case "max_output_tokens":
114	                    return StopReasonEnum.MAX_TOKENS
115	                case "content_filter":
116	                    return StopReasonEnum.REFUSAL
117	                case _:
118	                    return StopReasonEnum.END_TURN
119	
120	        # Check output items for any function calls
121	        for item in getattr(response, "output", []) or []:
122	            if getattr(item, "type", None) == "function_call":
123	                return StopReasonEnum.TOOL_USE
124	
125	        return StopReasonEnum.END_TURN

127	    def _normalize_completed_kwargs(
128	        self,
129	        additional_kwargs: dict[str, Any],
130	        response: Any,
131	        blocks: list[Any],
132	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
133	        """Add input_tokens, output_tokens, and stop_reason to additional_kwargs."""
134	        usage = getattr(response, "usage", None)
135	        if usage is not None:
136	            input_tokens = getattr(usage, "input_tokens", None)
137	            output_tokens = getattr(usage, "output_tokens", None)
138	            if input_tokens is not None:
139	                additional_kwargs["input_tokens"] = input_tokens
140	            if output_tokens is not None:
141	                additional_kwargs["output_tokens"] = output_tokens
142	
143	        # Prefer response-level stop reason; fall back to checking blocks
144	        stop_reason = self._get_stop_reason_from_response(response)
145	        if stop_reason == StopReasonEnum.END_TURN and any(
146	            isinstance(b, ToolCallBlock) for b in blocks
147	        ):
148	            stop_reason = StopReasonEnum.TOOL_USE
149	
150	        additional_kwargs["stop_reason"] = stop_reason
151	        return additional_kwargs

153	    @staticmethod
154	    def _normalize_messages_for_responses_api(
155	        messages: Sequence[ChatMessage],
156	    ) -> Sequence[ChatMessage]:
157	        """Move tool calls from additional_kwargs into message.blocks for the Responses.
158	
159	        After streaming, _handle_stream_chunk stores accumulated ToolSelection /
160	        ToolCallBlock objects in assistant_message.additional_kwargs["tool_calls"]
161	        while message.blocks stays empty.  to_openai_responses_message_dict uses the
162	        blocks path when blocks are present, so we move the tool calls there and remove
163	        the key to avoid the wrong serialization path (ToolSelection.model_dump()
164	        produces {"tool_id": …} instead of the required {"type": "function_call", …}).
165	        """
166	        from llama_index.core.llms.llm import ToolSelection
167	
168	        for message in messages:
169	            if message.role != MessageRole.ASSISTANT:
170	                continue
171	            raw_tool_calls = message.additional_kwargs.get("tool_calls")
172	            if not raw_tool_calls:
173	                continue
174	
175	            new_tool_blocks: list[ToolCallBlock] = []
176	            for tc in raw_tool_calls:
177	                if isinstance(tc, ToolCallBlock):
178	                    new_tool_blocks.append(tc)
179	                elif isinstance(tc, ToolSelection):
180	                    new_tool_blocks.append(
181	                        ToolCallBlock(
182	                            tool_call_id=tc.tool_id,
183	                            tool_name=tc.tool_name,
184	                            tool_kwargs=tc.tool_kwargs,
185	                        )
186	                    )
187	
188	            if new_tool_blocks:
189	                non_tool_blocks = [
190	                    b for b in message.blocks if not isinstance(b, ToolCallBlock)
191	                ]
192	                message.blocks = non_tool_blocks + new_tool_blocks
193	                del message.additional_kwargs["tool_calls"]
194	
195	        return messages

197	    def get_tool_calls_from_response(
198	        self,
199	        response: ChatResponse,
200	        error_on_no_tool_call: bool = True,
201	        **kwargs: Any,
202	    ) -> list[Any]:
203	        """Extract tool calls, falling back to additional_kwargs when blocks are empty.
204	
205	        The base implementation only checks message.blocks, but _handle_stream_chunk
206	        never accumulates blocks — it stores ToolCallBlock objects in
207	        message.additional_kwargs["tool_calls"] instead.  We check both locations.
208	        """
209	        from llama_index.core.llms.llm import ToolSelection
210	        from llama_index.core.llms.utils import parse_partial_json
211	
212	        # Non-streaming / ResponseCompletedEvent path: blocks populated directly
213	        tool_call_blocks = [
214	            b for b in response.message.blocks if isinstance(b, ToolCallBlock)
215	        ]
216	
217	        # Streaming accumulation path: _handle_stream_chunk stores them here
218	        if not tool_call_blocks:
219	            raw = response.message.additional_kwargs.get("tool_calls", [])
220	            tool_call_blocks = [tc for tc in raw if isinstance(tc, ToolCallBlock)]
221	
222	        if not tool_call_blocks:
223	            if error_on_no_tool_call:
224	                raise ValueError(
225	                    "Expected tool calls in response but found none. "
226	                    f"Message: {response.message}"
227	                )
228	            return []
229	
230	        tool_selections = []
231	        for b in tool_call_blocks:
232	            # tool_kwargs may be a JSON string (Responses API) or already a dict
233	            raw_kwargs = b.tool_kwargs
234	            if isinstance(raw_kwargs, str):
235	                try:
236	                    argument_dict = parse_partial_json(raw_kwargs) or {}
237	                except Exception:
238	                    argument_dict = {}
239	            else:
240	                argument_dict = raw_kwargs or {}
241	            tool_selections.append(
242	                ToolSelection(
243	                    tool_id=b.tool_call_id or "",
244	                    tool_name=b.tool_name,
245	                    tool_kwargs=argument_dict,
246	                )
247	            )
248	        return tool_selections

254	    def _get_model_kwargs(self, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
255	        """Handle reasoning_effort, structured_outputs, and BaseTool conversion."""
256	        # Pop our custom params before forwarding to the parent
257	        reasoning_effort = kwargs.pop("reasoning_effort", None)
258	        structured_outputs = kwargs.pop("structured_outputs", None)
259	        raw_tools = kwargs.pop("tools", None) or []
260	
261	        # Convert BaseTool objects to Responses API function-spec dicts
262	        from llama_index.core.tools.types import BaseTool
263	
264	        converted_tools: list[Any] = []
265	        for tool in raw_tools:
266	            if isinstance(tool, BaseTool):
267	                spec: dict[str, Any] = {
268	                    "type": "function",
269	                    **tool.metadata.to_openai_tool(skip_length_check=True)["function"],
270	                }
271	                if self.strict:
272	                    spec["strict"] = True
273	                    spec.get("parameters", {})["additionalProperties"] = False
274	                converted_tools.append(spec)
275	            else:
276	                converted_tools.append(tool)
277	
278	        kwargs["tools"] = converted_tools
279	
280	        model_kwargs = super()._get_model_kwargs(**kwargs)
281	
282	        # Apply reasoning from effort kwarg (overrides class-level reasoning_options)
283	        reasoning_options = self._ensure_valid_reasoning_effort(reasoning_effort)
284	        if reasoning_options is not None:
285	            model_kwargs["reasoning"] = reasoning_options
286	            for param in (
287	                "top_p",
288	                "temperature",
289	                "presence_penalty",
290	                "frequency_penalty",
291	            ):
292	                model_kwargs.pop(param, None)
293	
294	        # Map max_tokens → max_output_tokens if present
295	        if "max_tokens" in model_kwargs and "max_output_tokens" not in model_kwargs:
296	            model_kwargs["max_output_tokens"] = model_kwargs.pop("max_tokens")
297	        elif "max_tokens" in model_kwargs:
298	            model_kwargs.pop("max_tokens")
299	
300	        # Apply structured outputs as Responses API text.format
301	        if structured_outputs is not None:
302	            text_format = self._build_responses_text_format(structured_outputs)
303	            if text_format is not None:
304	                model_kwargs["text"] = {"format": text_format}
305	
306	        return model_kwargs

308	    def _stream_chat(
309	        self, messages: Sequence[ChatMessage], **kwargs: Any
310	    ) -> ChatResponseGen:
311	        """Stream chat with thinking_delta, stop_reason, and usage normalization."""
312	        from llama_index.llms.openai import (  # ty:ignore[unresolved-import]
313	            OpenAIResponses as _OpenAIResponsesBase,
314	        )
315	        from llama_index.llms.openai.utils import (  # ty:ignore[unresolved-import]
316	            to_openai_message_dicts,
317	        )
318	        from openai.types.responses import (  # ty:ignore[unresolved-import]
319	            ResponseCompletedEvent,
320	            ResponseReasoningSummaryTextDeltaEvent,
321	            ResponseReasoningTextDeltaEvent,
322	        )
323	
324	        messages = self._normalize_messages_for_responses_api(messages)
325	        message_dicts = to_openai_message_dicts(
326	            messages,
327	            model=self.model,
328	            is_responses_api=True,
329	        )
330	
331	        def gen() -> ChatResponseGen:
332	            built_in_tool_calls: list[Any] = []
333	            additional_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {"built_in_tool_calls": []}
334	            current_tool_call: ResponseFunctionToolCall | None = None
335	            local_previous_response_id = self._previous_response_id
336	
337	            create_response = cast(Any, self._client.responses.create)
338	            for event in create_response(
339	                input=message_dicts,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
340	                stream=True,
341	                **self._get_model_kwargs(**kwargs),
342	            ):
343	                # Reasoning deltas: put thinking_delta in ChatMessage.additional_kwargs
344	                # so _extract_reasoning (which checks chunk.message.additional_kwargs)
345	                # can pick it up.  Do NOT set it in the outer additional_kwargs dict —
346	                # that dict persists across iterations and would corrupt later chunks.
347	                if isinstance(
348	                    event,
349	                    ResponseReasoningSummaryTextDeltaEvent
350	                    | ResponseReasoningTextDeltaEvent,
351	                ):
352	                    if event.delta:
353	                        yield ChatResponse(
354	                            message=ChatMessage(
355	                                role="assistant",
356	                                blocks=[],
357	                                additional_kwargs={"thinking_delta": event.delta},
358	                            ),
359	                            delta="",
360	                            raw=event,
361	                            additional_kwargs=dict(additional_kwargs),
362	                        )
363	                    continue
364	
365	                (
366	                    blocks,
367	                    built_in_tool_calls,
368	                    additional_kwargs,
369	                    current_tool_call,
370	                    local_previous_response_id,
371	                    delta,
372	                ) = _OpenAIResponsesBase.process_response_event(
373	                    event=event,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
374	                    built_in_tool_calls=built_in_tool_calls,
375	                    additional_kwargs=additional_kwargs,
376	                    current_tool_call=current_tool_call,
377	                    track_previous_responses=self.track_previous_responses,
378	                    previous_response_id=local_previous_response_id,
379	                )
380	
381	                if (
382	                    self.track_previous_responses
383	                    and local_previous_response_id != self._previous_response_id
384	                ):
385	                    self._previous_response_id = local_previous_response_id
386	
387	                if built_in_tool_calls:
388	                    additional_kwargs["built_in_tool_calls"] = built_in_tool_calls
389	
390	                if isinstance(event, ResponseCompletedEvent):
391	                    additional_kwargs = self._normalize_completed_kwargs(
392	                        additional_kwargs,
393	                        event.response,
394	                        blocks,
395	                    )
396	                    stop_reason = additional_kwargs.get("stop_reason")
397	                    # Put ToolCallBlocks in message.additional_kwargs["tool_calls"]
398	                    # so _handle_stream_chunk accumulates them and
399	                    # get_tool_calls_from_response can find them via the fallback path
400	                    # (blocks are never accumulated by _handle_stream_chunk).
401	                    tool_call_blocks = [
402	                        b for b in blocks if isinstance(b, ToolCallBlock)
403	                    ]
404	                    message_extra: dict[str, Any] = {"stop_reason": stop_reason}
405	                    if tool_call_blocks:
406	                        message_extra["tool_calls"] = tool_call_blocks
407	                    message = ChatMessage(
408	                        role="assistant",
409	                        blocks=blocks,
410	                        additional_kwargs=message_extra,
411	                    )
412	                    yield ChatResponse(
413	                        message=message,
414	                        delta=delta,
415	                        raw=event,
416	                        additional_kwargs=additional_kwargs,
417	                    )
418	                    continue
419	
420	                yield ChatResponse(
421	                    message=ChatMessage(role="assistant", blocks=blocks),
422	                    delta=delta,
423	                    raw=event,
424	                    additional_kwargs=additional_kwargs,
425	                )
426	
427	        return gen()

544	    def _chat(self, messages: Sequence[ChatMessage], **kwargs: Any) -> ChatResponse:
545	        """Non-streaming chat with usage and stop_reason normalization."""
546	        messages = self._normalize_messages_for_responses_api(messages)
547	        chat_response: ChatResponse = super()._chat(messages, **kwargs)
548	
549	        usage = chat_response.additional_kwargs.get("usage")
550	        if usage is not None:
551	            input_tokens = getattr(usage, "input_tokens", None)
552	            output_tokens = getattr(usage, "output_tokens", None)
553	            if input_tokens is not None:
554	                chat_response.additional_kwargs["input_tokens"] = input_tokens
555	            if output_tokens is not None:
556	                chat_response.additional_kwargs["output_tokens"] = output_tokens
557	
558	        raw_response = getattr(chat_response, "raw", None)
559	        if raw_response is not None:
560	            stop_reason = self._get_stop_reason_from_response(raw_response)
561	        else:
562	            has_tool_calls = any(
563	                isinstance(b, ToolCallBlock) for b in chat_response.message.blocks
564	            )
565	            stop_reason = (
566	                StopReasonEnum.TOOL_USE if has_tool_calls else StopReasonEnum.END_TURN
567	            )
568	
569	        chat_response.additional_kwargs["stop_reason"] = stop_reason
570	        chat_response.message.additional_kwargs["stop_reason"] = stop_reason

from typing import Any

from llama_index.core.llms import LLM

from private_gpt.components.llm.factories.base import LLMFactory
from private_gpt.components.llm.prompt_helper import get_prompt_style
from private_gpt.components.llm.tokenizers.tokenizer_base import TokenizerBase
from private_gpt.settings.settings import LLMModelConfig, Settings
from private_gpt.utils.dependencies import format_missing_dependency_message


def _load_patched_openai_like() -> type[Any]:
    try:
        from private_gpt.components.llm.custom.openailike import PatchedOpenAILikeLLM

        return PatchedOpenAILikeLLM
    except ImportError as e:
        raise ImportError(
            format_missing_dependency_message(
                "OpenAI-like LLM",
                extras="llm-openai-compatible",
            )
        ) from e


class OpenAILikeCompletionsFactory(LLMFactory):
    """Chat Completions factory for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (vLLM, Ollama, etc.)."""

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings):
        super().__init__(settings)
        self.openai_settings = settings.openai

    def _create_llm(
        self, model_config: LLMModelConfig, tokenizer: TokenizerBase | None = None
    ) -> tuple[LLM, str | None]:
        PatchedOpenAILikeLLM = _load_patched_openai_like()

        prompt_style = (
            get_prompt_style(
                model_config.prompt_style or "default", tokenizer=tokenizer
            )
            if tokenizer
            else None
        )

        llm = PatchedOpenAILikeLLM(
            api_base=self.openai_settings.api_base,
            api_key=self.openai_settings.api_key or "default",
            model=model_config.name,
            is_chat_model=True,
            api_version="",
            temperature=model_config.sampling_params.temperature or 0.1,
            context_window=model_config.context_window or 3900,
            max_tokens=model_config.sampling_params.max_new_tokens or 1024,
            messages_to_prompt=prompt_style.messages_to_prompt
            if prompt_style
            else None,
            completion_to_prompt=prompt_style.completion_to_prompt
            if prompt_style
            else None,
            tokenizer=model_config.tokenizer,
            timeout=120.0,
            reuse_client=False,
            logprobs=False,
            is_function_calling_model=bool(model_config.support_tools),
        )

        return llm, model_config.alias

31	    def __init__(self, settings: Settings) -> None:

47	    def load_tokenizer(
48	        self, model_config: LLMModelConfig, raise_exception: bool = True
49	    ) -> TokenizerBase | None:
50	        """Load tokenizer if specified in model config."""
51	        try:
52	            tokenizer_mode = model_config.tokenizer_mode or "default"
53	            resolved_model_id = model_config.tokenizer or ""

55	            cache_key = f"{tokenizer_mode}::{resolved_model_id}"

61	                kwargs.update(
62	                    {

61	    def _build_openai_response_format(

63	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
64	        """Convert StructuredOutputsParams to an OpenAI response_format dict."""
65	        from private_gpt.components.llm.custom.base import (

67	        )

70	        if structured_outputs is None:

72	
73	        if structured_outputs.json_schema:
74	            return {
75	                "type": "json_schema",

86	    def _normalize_chat_messages(
87	        self,
88	        messages: Sequence[ChatMessage],
89	    ) -> Sequence[ChatMessage]:
90	        """Normalize chat messages to ensure compatibility with OpenAI."""
91	        normalized = []
92	        for msg in messages:
93	            # OpenAI expects to have content even when it's None
94	            blocks = msg.blocks if msg.blocks else [TextBlock(text="")]
95	
96	            # The tool_uses has to be in OpenAI format
97	            tool_calls = msg.additional_kwargs.get("tool_calls", [])
98	            if tool_calls:
99	                from openai.types.chat.chat_completion_chunk import (  # ty:ignore[unresolved-import]
100	                    ChoiceDeltaToolCall,
101	                    ChoiceDeltaToolCallFunction,
102	                )
103	
104	                openai_tool_calls = []
105	                for i, tool_call in enumerate(tool_calls):
106	                    if isinstance(tool_call, ChoiceDeltaToolCall):
107	                        openai_tool_calls.append(tool_call)
108	                    elif isinstance(tool_call, ToolSelection):
109	                        openai_tool_calls.append(
110	                            ChoiceDeltaToolCall(
111	                                index=i,
112	                                id=tool_call.tool_id,
113	                                type="function",
114	                                function=ChoiceDeltaToolCallFunction(
115	                                    name=tool_call.tool_name,
116	                                    arguments=json.dumps(tool_call.tool_kwargs),
117	                                ),
118	                            )
119	                        )
120	                msg.additional_kwargs["tool_calls"] = openai_tool_calls
121	
122	            normalized.append(
123	                ChatMessage(
124	                    role=msg.role,
125	                    blocks=blocks,
126	                    additional_kwargs=msg.additional_kwargs,
127	                )

132	        self,

135	        """Normalize OpenAI-specific fields to the unified format."""
136	        from openai.types.chat.chat_completion_chunk import (  # ty:ignore[unresolved-import]
137	            ChatCompletionChunk,
138	        )
139	
140	        raw = cast(ChatCompletionChunk, chat_response.raw)
141	
142	        # Normalize usage keys

144	        if "prompt_tokens" in additional_kwargs:
145	            additional_kwargs["input_tokens"] = additional_kwargs.pop("prompt_tokens")
146	        if "completion_tokens" in additional_kwargs:
147	            additional_kwargs["output_tokens"] = additional_kwargs.pop(
148	                "completion_tokens"
149	            )
150	        additional_kwargs.pop("total_tokens", None)

152	        # Extract finish_reason and convert to stop_reason
153	        if raw is not None and len(raw.choices) > 0:
154	            finish_reason = raw.choices[0].finish_reason
155	            if finish_reason is not None:
156	                stop_reason = StopReasonEnum.convert_from_openai(finish_reason)
157	                if stop_reason is not None:
158	                    additional_kwargs["stop_reason"] = stop_reason
159	                    chat_response.message.additional_kwargs["stop_reason"] = stop_reason

164	        self,

168	        from openai.types.chat.chat_completion_chunk import (  # ty:ignore[unresolved-import]

172	
173	        response = cast(ChatCompletionChunk, chat_response.raw)

176	        else:

192	            chat_response.message.additional_kwargs["thinking_delta"] = reasoning_delta

1	# router_runtime.py (vendored by router-migrate; safe to read, edit or delete)
2	#
3	# Routes this codebase's OpenAI / Anthropic SDK traffic through Ramp's Router (https://router.com) when
4	# RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY is set. When it is not set, every function here returns its input unchanged.
5	#
6	# How: an httpx transport placed under the SDK client (installed in place, so the client's proxies, mounts, headers and
7	# hooks all stay). It sends requests Router can serve to Router and forwards everything else to the original provider
8	# untouched:
9	#   POST .../chat/completions  -> POST {router}/v1/responses   (request + response + SSE stream translated back)
10	#   POST .../responses         -> POST {router}/v1/responses   (store dropped; previous_response_id chains kept in-process)
11	#   POST .../v1/messages       -> POST {router}/v1/messages    (Anthropic, model id mapped)
12	#   anything else (embeddings, images, audio, files, models, unknown models, n>1, logprobs, seed, beta headers,
13	#   provider-side vector stores/files) -> original provider
14	# If Router rejects a request before generating (unknown/unsupported parameter, model not available to this key, 501),
15	# the original request is sent to the provider instead, once.
16	# Each Router request carries metadata.feature = "<file>:<function>" of the calling code (ROUTER_MIGRATE_FEATURE_TAG=off
17	# disables it; it sends a repo-relative path and function name).
18	# Env: RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY (required to activate), RAMP_ROUTER_BASE_URL (default https://api.router.com),
19	#      ROUTER_MIGRATE_DISABLE=1 (kill switch), ROUTER_MIGRATE_MODEL_MAP='{"old-model":"router-id"}',
20	#      ROUTER_MIGRATE_SERVICE_TIER (unset: Router's account default, Flex where offered; set a tier to force it everywhere),
21	#      ROUTER_MIGRATE_FALLBACK=0 (surface Router errors instead of retrying on the provider).
22	# The provider key (OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) must stay configured: SDK constructors require it, and requests
23	# Router cannot serve still go to the provider.
24	import json
25	import os
26	import re
27	import sys
28	import threading
29	import time
30	import uuid
31	from collections import OrderedDict
32	
33	import importlib
34	
35	# openai-python <= 2.x and anthropic use `httpx`; openai-python >= 3 uses `httpx2` (same API). The transport classes are built
36	# for whichever library each client actually uses.
37	_LIBS = {}
38	
39	
40	def _lib(name):
41	    if name not in _LIBS:
42	        try:
43	            _LIBS[name] = importlib.import_module(name)
44	        except ImportError:
45	            _LIBS[name] = None
46	    return _LIBS[name]
47	
48	
49	httpx = _lib("httpx") or _lib("httpx2")
50	
51	__all__ = ["active", "wrap_openai", "wrap_anthropic", "wrap_langchain", "http_client", "async_http_client", "install_openai_module"]
52	VERSION = "0.1.0"
53	
54	# --- catalog (generated from GET /v1/models by router-migrate; refresh with `router-migrate apply --live`) -------
55	# id -> [owned_by, temperature_supported, reasoning_supported]
56	CATALOG = {}  # filled below by _load_catalog()
57	ALIASES = {}
58	DATED = {}  # dated provider snapshot -> catalog id, only where Router itself reported the equivalence
59	_CATALOG_JSON = r"""__ROUTER_CATALOG__"""
60	
61	_OPENAI_HOSTS = ("api.openai.com",)
62	_ANTHROPIC_HOSTS = ("api.anthropic.com",)
63	_SKIP_FRAMES = ("site-packages", "dist-packages", os.sep + "lib" + os.sep + "python", "router_runtime", "<frozen")
64	
65	
66	def _load_catalog():
67	    try:
68	        d = json.loads(_CATALOG_JSON)
69	    except ValueError:

94	def resolve_model(name):
95	    """Router id for a model name, or None when Router cannot serve that exact model (then the provider keeps it)."""
96	    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
97	        return None
98	    try:
99	        override = json.loads(os.environ.get("ROUTER_MIGRATE_MODEL_MAP") or "{}")
100	    except ValueError:

102	    if name in override:

113	    """'<relative file>:<function>' of the first stack frame that belongs to this codebase (ROUTER_MIGRATE_FEATURE_TAG=off disables)."""
114	    if not _feature_tags_on():

116	    f = sys._getframe(1)

133	    if isinstance(content, str):

360	        try:
361	            if __package__:

390	def _glob_re(pat):
391	    out, i = "", 0
392	    while i < len(pat):
393	        if pat.startswith("**", i):
394	            out, i = out + ".*", i + 2
395	        elif pat[i] == "*":
396	            out, i = out + "[^/]*", i + 1
397	        elif pat[i] == "?":
398	            out, i = out + "[^/]", i + 1
399	        else:
400	            out, i = out + re.escape(pat[i]), i + 1
401	    return re.compile("^" + out + "$")

404	def policy_for(feature, policy=None):
405	    """Effective settings for a feature id: exact feature > longest matching glob > defaults, per key; metadata merged."""
406	    p = policy if policy is not None else _load_policy()
407	    if not p:
408	        return {}
409	    layers = [p.get("defaults") or {}]
410	    if feature:
411	        globs = sorted(((g, e) for g, e in (p.get("globs") or {}).items() if _glob_re(g).match(feature)), key=lambda x: (len(x[0]), x[0]))
412	        layers += [e for _, e in globs]
413	        if feature in (p.get("features") or {}):
414	            layers.append(p["features"][feature])
415	    eff, meta = {}, {}
416	    for e in layers:
417	        for k, v in e.items():
418	            if k == "metadata":
419	                meta.update(v)
420	            else:
421	                eff[k] = v
422	    if meta:
423	        eff["metadata"] = meta
424	    return eff

460	def _apply_policy(nb, caller_body, feature):
461	    """Mutates a Router-bound /v1/responses body per the compiled policy. No policy => untouched."""
462	    p = _load_policy()
463	    if not p:
464	        return nb
465	    fid = ((caller_body.get("metadata") or {}).get("feature") if isinstance(caller_body.get("metadata"), dict) else None) or feature
466	    eff = policy_for(fid, p)
467	    if not eff:
468	        return nb
469	    if eff.get("metadata"):
470	        meta = dict(nb.get("metadata") or {})
471	        for k, v in eff["metadata"].items():
472	            if k in meta:
473	                continue  # the request's own keys win (incl. v1's metadata.feature)
474	            if len(meta) >= 16:
475	                _policy_log("meta16:%s" % fid, "metadata cap reached for %s: policy keys dropped" % fid)
476	                break
477	            meta[k] = v
478	        nb["metadata"] = meta
479	    if eff.get("prompt_cache_key") and "prompt_cache_key" not in nb:
480	        key = eff["prompt_cache_key"]
481	        if "$feature" in key:
482	            key = key.replace("$feature", fid) if fid else None
483	        if key:
484	            nb["prompt_cache_key"] = key[:200]
485	    if eff.get("provider_timeout") and "provider_timeout" not in nb:
486	        nb["provider_timeout"] = eff["provider_timeout"]
487	    if eff.get("service_tier") and caller_body.get("service_tier") is None and "allow_flex_tier" not in eff:
488	        nb["service_tier"] = eff["service_tier"]
489	    caller_tier = caller_body.get("service_tier") is not None
490	    flex = eff.get("allow_flex_tier")
491	    if flex is True and not (CATALOG.get(nb.get("model")) or {}).get("c", {}).get("f"):
492	        _policy_log("flex:%s" % fid, "allow_flex_tier skipped for %s: %s has no flex tier" % (fid, nb.get("model")))
493	        flex = None
494	    if flex is not None and not caller_tier:
495	        nb.pop("service_tier", None)
496	        nb["allow_flex_tier"] = flex
497	    if eff.get("fallbacks"):
498	        seen, cands = set(), []
499	        for c in eff["fallbacks"]:
500	            if c not in seen and _candidate_ok(c, nb, nb.get("model")):
501	                cands.append(c)
502	            seen.add(c)
503	        if len(cands) < len(seen):
504	            _policy_log("fb:%s" % fid, "fallbacks for %s: %d of %d candidates dropped by the capability guard" % (fid, len(seen) - len(cands), len(seen)))
505	        if cands:
506	            nb["models"] = [nb.pop("model")] + cands
507	            if nb.pop("allow_flex_tier", None) is not None and not caller_tier:
508	                _service_tier(nb)  # flex does not apply to a models list [measured]
509	                _policy_log("flexfb:%s" % fid, "allow_flex_tier dropped for %s: Router ignores Flex with a models list (fallbacks win)" % fid)
510	    return nb

568	class _SSE:
569	    """Incremental SSE parser: bytes in, decoded JSON events out. Handles \r\n framing and events split across reads."""
570	
571	    def __init__(self):
572	        self.buf = b""
573	
574	    def feed(self, data, final=False):
575	        self.buf = (self.buf + data).replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
576	        if final and self.buf.strip():
577	            self.buf += b"\n\n"
578	        out = []
579	        while b"\n\n" in self.buf:
580	            raw, self.buf = self.buf.split(b"\n\n", 1)
581	            lines = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace").split("\n")
582	            data_ = "\n".join(l[5:].lstrip() if l.startswith("data:") else "" for l in lines if l.startswith("data:"))
583	            if not data_ or data_ == "[DONE]":
584	                continue
585	            try:
586	                ev = json.loads(data_)
587	            except ValueError:
588	                continue
589	            if isinstance(ev, dict):
590	                ev.setdefault("type", next((l[6:].strip() for l in lines if l.startswith("event:")), ""))
591	                out.append(ev)
592	        return out

612	class _ChunkWriter:
613	    """Turns Router Responses SSE events into chat.completion.chunk SSE lines."""
614	
615	    def __init__(self, ctx):
616	        self.ctx, self.sse, self.done, self.id, self.created, self.model = ctx, _SSE(), False, None, int(time.time()), ctx.get("model")
617	        self.tool_index, self.args_sent, self.text_tail, self.emitted_role, self.stopped = {}, {}, "", False, False
618	        self.maxstop = max([len(s) for s in ctx.get("stops") or []] or [0])
619	
620	    def _chunk(self, delta, finish=None, usage=None, choices=True):
621	        d = {"id": "chatcmpl-" + str(self.id or "router"), "object": "chat.completion.chunk", "created": self.created, "model": self.model,
622	             "system_fingerprint": None, "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": delta, "finish_reason": finish, "logprobs": None}] if choices else []}
623	        if usage is not None:
624	            d["usage"] = usage
625	        return ("data: " + json.dumps(d) + "\n\n").encode()
626	
627	    def _text(self, s, final=False):
628	        if self.stopped:
629	            return []
630	        if not self.maxstop:
631	            return [self._chunk({"content": s})] if s else []
632	        self.text_tail += s
633	        cut, hit = _cut(self.text_tail, self.ctx["stops"])
634	        if hit:
635	            self.stopped = True
636	            return [self._chunk({"content": cut})] if cut else []
637	        keep = 0 if final else self.maxstop - 1
638	        emit, self.text_tail = (self.text_tail[:len(self.text_tail) - keep], self.text_tail[len(self.text_tail) - keep:]) if keep else (self.text_tail, "")
639	        return [self._chunk({"content": emit})] if emit else []
640	
641	    def feed(self, data):
642	        out = []
643	        for ev in self.sse.feed(data):
644	            out.extend(self._event(ev))
645	        return out
646	
647	    def finish(self):
648	        """End of the upstream body: flush a final event without a trailing blank line, then close the stream properly."""
649	        out = [] if self.done else [x for ev in self.sse.feed(b"", final=True) for x in self._event(ev)]
650	        if not self.done:
651	            out.extend(self._text("", final=True))
652	            out.append(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
653	            self.done = True
654	        return out

656	    def _tool(self, item, out):
657	        key = item.get("id") or item.get("call_id")
658	        if key not in self.tool_index:
659	            self.tool_index[key] = len(self.tool_index)
660	            self.args_sent[key] = ""
661	            out.append(self._call_delta(key, {"name": item.get("name"), "arguments": ""}, item.get("call_id")))
662	        return key

664	    def _call_delta(self, key, fn, call_id=None):
665	        if self.ctx.get("legacy_functions"):
666	            return self._chunk({"function_call": fn})
667	        tc = {"index": self.tool_index[key], "function": fn}
668	        if call_id is not None:
669	            tc.update(id=call_id, type="function")
670	        return self._chunk({"tool_calls": [tc]})

672	    def _args(self, key, full, out):
673	        """Emit whatever part of the final arguments was not streamed as deltas (some providers only send .done)."""
674	        sent = self.args_sent.get(key, "")
675	        if full and full.startswith(sent) and len(full) > len(sent):
676	            out.append(self._call_delta(key, {"arguments": full[len(sent):]}))
677	            self.args_sent[key] = full

679	    def _event(self, ev):
680	        if self.done:
681	            return []
682	        t = ev.get("type", "")
683	        out = []
684	        if not self.emitted_role and t.startswith("response."):
685	            r = ev.get("response") or {}
686	            self.id = r.get("id") or self.id
687	            self.model = r.get("model") or self.model
688	            self.emitted_role = True
689	            out.append(self._chunk({"role": "assistant", "content": ""}))
690	        if t == "response.output_text.delta":
691	            out.extend(self._text(ev.get("delta", "")))
692	        elif t == "response.refusal.delta":
693	            out.append(self._chunk({"refusal": ev.get("delta", "")}))
694	        elif t == "response.output_item.added" and (ev.get("item") or {}).get("type") == "function_call":
695	            self._tool(ev["item"], out)
696	        elif t == "response.function_call_arguments.delta":
697	            key = ev.get("item_id")
698	            if key not in self.tool_index:
699	                key = self._tool({"id": key, "call_id": ev.get("call_id"), "name": ev.get("name")}, out)
700	            self.args_sent[key] = self.args_sent.get(key, "") + ev.get("delta", "")
701	            out.append(self._call_delta(key, {"arguments": ev.get("delta", "")}))
702	        elif t == "response.function_call_arguments.done":
703	            key = ev.get("item_id")
704	            if key in self.tool_index:
705	                self._args(key, ev.get("arguments") or "", out)
706	        elif t == "response.output_item.done" and (ev.get("item") or {}).get("type") == "function_call":
707	            key = self._tool(ev["item"], out)
708	            self._args(key, ev["item"].get("arguments") or "", out)
709	        elif t in ("response.completed", "response.incomplete"):
710	            out.extend(self._text("", final=True))
711	            r = ev.get("response") or {}
712	            inc = (r.get("incomplete_details") or {}).get("reason")
713	            if inc == "content_filter":
714	                finish = "content_filter"
715	            elif inc == "max_output_tokens" and not self.stopped:
716	                finish = "length"  # also for a tool call cut off mid-arguments, as Chat Completions reports it
717	            elif self.tool_index:
718	                finish = "function_call" if self.ctx.get("legacy_functions") else "tool_calls"
719	            else:
720	                finish = "stop"
721	            out.append(self._chunk({}, finish=finish))
722	            if self.ctx.get("include_usage"):
723	                out.append(self._chunk({}, usage=_usage(r.get("usage")), choices=False))
724	            out.append(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
725	            self.done = True
726	        elif t in ("response.failed", "error"):
727	            err = (ev.get("response") or {}).get("error") or ev.get("error") or {"message": ev.get("message", "Router stream error")}
728	            out.append(("data: " + json.dumps({"error": err}) + "\n\n").encode())
729	            out.append(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
730	            self.done = True
731	        return out

840	def _local_retrieve(req):
841	    """GET /responses/{id} for a Router-issued id: answer from memory; the provider never saw it."""
842	    m = re.search(r"/responses/([^/?]+)(/input_items)?$", req.url.path)
843	    if not m or m.group(1) not in _ROUTER_IDS:
844	        return None
845	    rid = m.group(1)
846	    if rid not in _CHAINS:
847	        return _local_error(404, "Response %s was served by Router and is no longer in this process's memory." % rid)
848	    items, _, full = _CHAINS[rid]
849	    if req.method == "DELETE":
850	        del _CHAINS[rid]
851	        return ("local", 200, {"id": rid, "object": "response", "deleted": True})
852	    if m.group(2):
853	        return ("local", 200, {"object": "list", "data": items, "first_id": None, "last_id": None, "has_more": False})
854	    return ("local", 200, full)

886	def _adapt(body, feature, origin=None):
887	    """The Router-bound copy of a request with this feature's accepted trade-offs applied (policy drop_params): listed
888	    parameters are dropped, a listed output cap is raised to Router's minimum of 16, and a listed `name` is folded into the
889	    message text. The original request is untouched, so a fallback to the provider still sends exactly what the code built."""
890	    drop = _policy_key("drop_params", body, feature, origin) or []
891	    if not drop:
892	        return body
893	    b = dict(body)
894	    for k in drop:
895	        if k in _MAX_TOKEN_KEYS:
896	            if isinstance(b.get(k), int) and b[k] < 16:
897	                b[k] = 16
898	        elif k == "name" and isinstance(b.get("messages"), list):
899	            b["messages"] = [dict({kk: vv for kk, vv in m.items() if kk != "name"},
900	                                  content=("%s: %s" % (m["name"], m["content"])) if isinstance(m.get("content"), str) else m.get("content"))
901	                             if isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("name") and m.get("role") not in ("function", "tool") else m
902	                             for m in b["messages"]]
903	        else:
904	            b.pop(k, None)
905	    return b

17	    "mode": "openai",

34	def _capability_supported(capability: Any, default: bool) -> bool:
35	    if capability is None:
36	        return default
37	
38	    supported = getattr(capability, "supported", None)
39	    if supported is not None:
40	        return bool(supported)
41	
42	    if isinstance(capability, Mapping):
43	        return bool(capability.get("supported", default))
44	
45	    return bool(capability)
46	
47	
48	def _capability_count(capability: Any, default_supported: bool) -> int | None:
49	    if not _capability_supported(capability, default_supported):
50	        return None
51	
52	    maximum = getattr(capability, "maximum", None)
53	    if isinstance(capability, Mapping):
54	        maximum = capability.get("maximum", maximum)
55	
56	    return positive_int(maximum) or 1

59	def _check_tokenizer_mode(
60	    model_info: ModelInfoOutput, tokenizer_mode: str, **kwargs: Any
61	) -> bool:
62	    try:
63	        tokenizer = get_tokenizer(tokenizer_mode, model_info.id, **kwargs)
64	        tokens = tokenizer.encode("Test tokenizer support", add_special_tokens=False)
65	    except Exception as exc:
66	        logger.warning(
67	            "This provider don't support %s mode for model '%s': %s",  # TODO: add link to dos
68	            tokenizer_mode,
69	            model_info.id,
70	            exc,
71	        )
72	        return False
73	    return bool(tokens)

76	def _probe_chat_completions_endpoint(
77	    api_base: str, api_key: str | None, model_id: str, timeout: float
78	) -> bool:
79	    """Return True if the chat/completions endpoint responds (non-404)."""
80	    import requests
81	
82	    url = api_base.rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
83	    headers: dict[str, str] = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
84	    if api_key:
85	        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {api_key}"
86	    payload = {
87	        "model": model_id,
88	        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "test"}],
89	        "max_tokens": 1,
90	    }
91	    try:
92	        resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
93	        return resp.status_code != 404
94	    except Exception as exc:
95	        logger.debug("Chat completions probe failed for %s: %s", api_base, exc)
96	        # Cannot reach server — conservatively assume the endpoint exists.
97	        return True
98	
99	
100	def _probe_responses_endpoint(
101	    api_base: str, api_key: str | None, model_id: str, timeout: float
102	) -> bool:
103	    """Return True if the responses endpoint responds (non-404)."""
104	    import requests
105	
106	    url = api_base.rstrip("/") + "/responses"
107	    headers: dict[str, str] = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
108	    if api_key:
109	        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {api_key}"
110	    payload = {
111	        "model": model_id,
112	        "input": "test",
113	        "max_output_tokens": 1,
114	    }
115	    try:
116	        resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
117	        return resp.status_code != 404
118	    except Exception as exc:
119	        logger.debug("Responses API probe failed for %s: %s", api_base, exc)
120	        return False
121	
122	
123	def _get_openai_api_type_for_model(model_id: str) -> str:
124	    """Return the api_type for a real OpenAI model using llama-index's model registry.
125	
126	    Models in RESPONSES_API_ONLY_MODELS (e.g. gpt-5.2-pro) must use the
127	    Responses API; all others default to chat_completions.
128	    """
129	    try:
130	        from llama_index.llms.openai.utils import (  # ty:ignore[unresolved-import]
131	            is_chatcomp_api_supported,
132	        )
133	
134	        return (
135	            "chat_completions" if is_chatcomp_api_supported(model_id) else "responses"
136	        )
137	    except ImportError:
138	        return "chat_completions"
139	
140	
141	def _probe_api_type(
142	    model_infos: list[ModelInfoOutput],
143	    api_base: str,
144	    api_key: str | None,
145	    timeout: float = DEFAULT_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT,
146	) -> str:
147	    """Detect which API type an OpenAI-compatible endpoint supports.
148	
149	    Probes chat/completions first; if that returns 404, falls back to responses.
150	    This function is only called for non-OpenAI endpoints — real OpenAI uses
151	    ``_get_openai_api_type_for_model`` per model instead.
152	    """
153	    if not model_infos:
154	        return str(DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["api_type"])
155	
156	    model_id = model_infos[0].id
157	
158	    if _probe_chat_completions_endpoint(api_base, api_key, model_id, timeout):
159	        logger.debug("Detected chat_completions API type for %s", api_base)
160	        return "chat_completions"
161	
162	    if _probe_responses_endpoint(api_base, api_key, model_id, timeout):
163	        logger.info(
164	            "chat/completions endpoint not found for %s; using Responses API", api_base
165	        )
166	        return "responses"
167	
168	    logger.debug(
169	        "Could not detect API type for %s, defaulting to chat_completions", api_base
170	    )
171	    return str(DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["api_type"])
172	
173	
174	def _model_info_to_config(
175	    model_info: ModelInfoOutput,
176	    tokenizer_mode: str,
177	    mode: str | None = None,
178	    provider: str | None = None,
179	    api_type: str = "chat_completions",
180	) -> LLMModelConfig:
181	    from private_gpt.settings.settings import LLMModelConfig, SamplingParams
182	
183	    capabilities = model_info.capabilities
184	    supports_reasoning = DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["support_reasoning"]
185	    supports_tools = DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["support_tools"]
186	    support_image: int | None = DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["support_image"]
187	    support_audio: int | None = DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["support_audio"]
188	
189	    if capabilities is not None:
190	        supports_reasoning = _capability_supported(
191	            capabilities.thinking, supports_reasoning
192	        ) or _capability_supported(capabilities.effort, supports_reasoning)
193	        supports_tools = _capability_supported(
194	            capabilities.structured_outputs, supports_tools
195	        )
196	        support_image = _capability_count(capabilities.image_input, bool(support_image))
197	        support_audio = _capability_count(capabilities.audio_input, bool(support_audio))
198	
199	    # Default privateGPT values
200	    mode = mode or DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["mode"]
201	    prompt_style = DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["prompt_style"]
202	
203	    max_new_tokens = positive_int(model_info.max_tokens)
204	    sampling_params = (
205	        SamplingParams(max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens)
206	        if max_new_tokens is not None
207	        else SamplingParams()
208	    )
209	
210	    return LLMModelConfig(
211	        name=model_info.id,
212	        mode=mode,
213	        provider=provider,
214	        prompt_style=prompt_style,
215	        tokenizer_mode=tokenizer_mode,
216	        enabled=True,
217	        alias=model_info.id,
218	        api_type=api_type,
219	        context_window=positive_int(model_info.max_input_tokens)
220	        or DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["context_window"],
221	        support_image=support_image,
222	        support_audio=support_audio,
223	        support_tools=supports_tools,
224	        support_reasoning=supports_reasoning,
225	        sampling_params=sampling_params,
226	        reasoning_sampling_params=sampling_params,
227	    )
228	
229	
230	def _get_tokenizer_mode(
231	    model_infos: list[ModelInfoOutput],
232	    api_base: str,
233	    api_key: str | None,
234	) -> str:
235	    if not model_infos:
236	        return str(DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["tokenizer_mode"])
237	
238	    first_model = model_infos[0]
239	    if _check_tokenizer_mode(
240	        first_model,
241	        "remote",
242	        api_base=api_base,
243	        api_key=api_key,
244	    ):
245	        return "remote"
246	
247	    return str(DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["tokenizer_mode"])
248	
249	
250	def get_models(
251	    api_base: str,
252	    api_key: str | None,
253	    *,
254	    mode: str | None = None,
255	    timeout: float = DEFAULT_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT,
256	    fetch_all_pages: bool = True,
257	    force_model_kind: bool = False,
258	) -> list[LLMModelConfig]:
259	    from private_gpt.components.model_discovery.url_utils import is_openai_api_base
260	
261	    discovery = discover_model_infos(
262	        api_base,
263	        api_key,
264	        force_kind=ModelKind.LLM if force_model_kind else None,
265	        timeout=timeout,
266	        fetch_all_pages=fetch_all_pages,
267	    )
268	    model_infos = list(discovery.llm_models)
269	    tokenizer_mode = _get_tokenizer_mode(
270	        model_infos,
271	        api_base=api_base,
272	        api_key=api_key,
273	    )
274	
275	    # For real OpenAI, determine api_type per model (some models are responses-only).
276	    # For other endpoints, probe once and apply the result to all models.
277	    use_per_model_openai = is_openai_api_base(api_base)
278	    probed_api_type: str | None = None
279	    if not use_per_model_openai:
280	        probed_api_type = _probe_api_type(model_infos, api_base, api_key, timeout)
281	
282	    configs: list[LLMModelConfig] = []
283	    for model_info in model_infos:
284	        api_type = (
285	            _get_openai_api_type_for_model(model_info.id)
286	            if use_per_model_openai
287	            else (probed_api_type or str(DEFAULT_MODELS_VALUES["api_type"]))
288	        )
289	        configs.append(
290	            _model_info_to_config(
291	                model_info,
292	                tokenizer_mode=tokenizer_mode,
293	                mode=mode,
294	                provider=discovery.provider.value,
295	                api_type=api_type,
296	            )
297	        )
298	
299	    return configs

from typing import cast

from llama_index.core.llms import LLM

from private_gpt.components.llm.factories.base import LLMFactory
from private_gpt.components.llm.factories.responses.generic import (
    OpenAIResponsesLLMLoader,
)
from private_gpt.components.llm.tokenizers.tokenizer_base import TokenizerBase
from private_gpt.router_runtime import wrap_openai
from private_gpt.settings.settings import LLMModelConfig, Settings


class OpenAIResponsesFactory(OpenAIResponsesLLMLoader, LLMFactory):
    """Responses API factory for the real OpenAI endpoint (api.openai.com)."""

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings):
        super().__init__(settings)
        self.openai_settings = settings.openai

    def _create_llm(
        self, model_config: LLMModelConfig, tokenizer: TokenizerBase | None = None
    ) -> tuple[LLM, str | None]:
        PatchedOpenAIResponsesLLM = self._load_patched_openai_responses()

        llm = cast(
            LLM,
            PatchedOpenAIResponsesLLM(
                model=model_config.name,
                api_key=self.openai_settings.api_key,
                api_base=self.openai_settings.api_base or "https://api.openai.com/v1",
            ),
        )

        return llm, model_config.alias

from llama_index.core.llms import LLM

from private_gpt.components.llm.factories.base import LLMFactory
from private_gpt.components.llm.factories.responses.generic import (
    OpenAIResponsesLLMLoader,
)

from private_gpt.router_runtime import wrap_openai
from private_gpt.settings.settings import LLMModelConfig, Settings


class OpenAIResponsesFactory(OpenAIResponsesLLMLoader, LLMFactory):
    """Responses API factory for the real OpenAI endpoint (api.openai.com)."""

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings):
        super().__init__(settings)
        self.openai_settings = settings.openai

    def _create_llm(
        self, model_config: LLMModelConfig, tokenizer: TokenizerBase | None = None
    ) -> tuple[LLM, str | None]:
        PatchedOpenAIResponsesLLM = self._load_patched_openai_responses()

        llm = cast(
            LLM,
            PatchedOpenAIResponsesLLM(
                model=model_config.name,
                api_key=self.openai_settings.api_key,
                api_base=self.openai_settings.api_base or "https://api.openai.com/v1",
            ),
        )
        wrap_openai(llm._client)  # noqa: SLF001
        wrap_openai(llm._aclient)  # noqa: SLF001

        return llm, model_config.alias

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: str = DEFAULT_OPENAI_MODEL,
        temperature: float = DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE,
        max_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
        additional_kwargs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        max_retries: int = 3,
        timeout: float = 60.0,
        reuse_client: bool = True,
        api_key: Optional[str] = None,
        api_base: Optional[str] = None,
        api_version: Optional[str] = None,
        callback_manager: Optional[CallbackManager] = None,
        default_headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        http_client: Optional[httpx.Client] = None,
        async_http_client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None,
        openai_client: Optional[SyncOpenAI] = None,
        async_openai_client: Optional[AsyncOpenAI] = None,
        # base class
        system_prompt: Optional[str] = None,
        messages_to_prompt: Optional[Callable[[Sequence[ChatMessage]], str]] = None,
        completion_to_prompt: Optional[Callable[[str], str]] = None,
        pydantic_program_mode: PydanticProgramMode = PydanticProgramMode.DEFAULT,
        output_parser: Optional[BaseOutputParser] = None,
        strict: bool = False,
        reasoning_effort: Optional[
            Literal["none", "minimal", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh"]
        ] = None,
        modalities: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        audio_config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        # TODO: Support deprecated max_new_tokens
        if "max_new_tokens" in kwargs:
            max_tokens = kwargs["max_new_tokens"]
            del kwargs["max_new_tokens"]

        additional_kwargs = additional_kwargs or {}

        api_key, api_base, api_version = resolve_openai_credentials(
            api_key=api_key,
            api_base=api_base,
            api_version=api_version,
        )

        # TODO: Temp forced to 1.0 for o1
        if model in O1_MODELS:
            temperature = 1.0

        if not is_chatcomp_api_supported(model):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Cannot use model {model} as it is only supported by the Responses API. Use the OpenAIResponses class for it."
            )

        super().__init__(
            model=model,
            temperature=temperature,
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            additional_kwargs=additional_kwargs,
            max_retries=max_retries,
            callback_manager=callback_manager,
